'''Brad Augsburger''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Normal DPC Team Event]] on 25 February 2001 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|flipping COTVG with scum]], according to Geoff Snider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1808">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-27-geoffs-dpc-team-eventd1808/ geoffs-dpc-team-event], DeckTech (Geoff "gsiva" Snider, 27 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-27-geoffs-dpc-team-eventd1808/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
